G/I captured later governance revisions. pendingUserBusinessDecisions: Whether to include the minimum four existing R5 role-assignment operations, two new controlled stage commands, and the necessary stage-entry bridge/tightened creation policy.
Whether receiptAmount is gross cash and which immutable same-contract net/tax/currency basis and legacy-correction boundary applies.
Whether and where users explicitly include/exclude actual costs, with traceable eligibility/source-chain evidence.

independentlyRecheckedSourcePoints.subject: Gross margin drift
independentlyRecheckedSourcePoints.observation: Node currently subtracts included cost from contract total and divides by contract total. Formal design uses confirmed receipt net less included actual-cost net, with confirmed receipt net as denominator. Existing Node expectations cannot certify the corrected formula.

independentlyRecheckedSourcePoints.subject: Seeded producer outputs
independentlyRecheckedSourcePoints.observation: Seeder directly inserts DMER, OSER and gate binding. Reads/reviews against those seed IDs do not establish the real G-to-H producer chain. This review did not independently repeat the authors' exhaustive negative producer searches.

independentlyRecheckedSourcePoints.subject: Handover and stage bypass
independentlyRecheckedSourcePoints.observation: Current confirmed handover view explicitly denies execution admission pending a same-chain R5 freeze. Project creation currently persists supplied currentStage, defaulting to assessment. Advanced-stage fixture creation cannot establish the missing controlled business chain. Policy tightening and additional commands remain proposals until frozen.

independentlyRecheckedSourcePoints.subject: Project action versus stage-specific gates
independentlyRecheckedSourcePoints.observation: Project currentActionLevel has the L2 severity floor. Four stage gates use their own signal matrix and highest-severity aggregation, including parallel reasons; project action is not a substitute. Exact standalone-L2-to-stage behavior must be frozen rather than inferred from the project floor.
